An alert when a watchlist share shows quiet buying, churn, deals or promoter buying or selling; and a round-up of the whole market in the evening (or the next morning)
💰 Big Money: delivery, deals and promoters

Menu → Big Money. Every evening NSE\'s delivery file, the bulk/block deals and the promoters\' trades give each NSE share (main board and SME) four signals. 🟢 Quiet buying: today\'s delivery above 1.8 times its 20-session average, price within ±2% and over 1 lakh shares. 🔴 Churn / trap: volume above 4 times its average but delivery under 20%. 🤝 Deals: all deals of the last 30 sessions added up (bought − sold); net buying on 2 or more deal days in a row gives the signal, and a client who bought and sold within 5 sessions is named under \"round-trip deal\". 👔 Promoters: market buys − sales over 90 days (not ESOP, gifts or off-market). Score 0–100: up to 30 for the delivery spike, 20 for building up, 25 for deals and 25 for promoters; churn takes 30 off and net selling takes off on the same scale. Each signal comes with its past year: how often it showed and how the price moved 10 sessions later on average, against all shares\' average. The list marks 🟢 Buying or 🔴 Trap, Filters offer \"Only quiet buying\" or \"Hide churn\", and the stock detail has the whole card. A watchlist share with a signal gets an alert, and the evening (or the next morning when the data is late) brings a round-up of the whole market; turn it off in Menu → Scan. BSE-only and trade-to-trade (BE, BZ) shares have no delivery data. This is data, not advice.
